title.narrative: Provision of essential health and psychosocial assistance reaching the vulnerable population in rural and hard-to-reach areas in North and North-East Ukraine

description.narrative: ltpgtThis prltspangtoject is planned to be implemented through mobile units that will be able to provide and reach the population in the areas where lt/spangtltspangtmedical care is obstructed, lt/spangtltspangtlacking completely, or the populationlt/spangtltspangt is not able to reach medical institutionslt/spangtltspangt. lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtWith the services of a general practitioner assisted by the medical nurse/technician, psychologist and lawyer these mobile teams will in logical rounds and where needed even ad-hoc visit the areas (villages, towns), and provide health services to the affected population. The working plan will always be coordinated with the authorities and relevant stakeholders for the specific community, to avoid overlapping and have a logical way of service provision to ensure maximum accessibility to the residents. Make sure that the working space is carefully selected, safe and easy to evacuate. lt/pgtltpgtAdditional focus will be on people with disabilities and the elderly population that aren't able to reach the health facilities, so the mobile teams will strive to reach them in their homes or centres where these vulnerable groups reside. To ensure that their needs with regular therapies and other necessities are fulfilled as much as possible. Medical services will be available to the residents of preselected areas 4-5 working days per week for 8 hours, except for some emergencies and unexpected situations. lt/pgtltpgtltspangtGeneral doctorslt/spangtltspangt and nurses will assist the adults and children, solving acute situations and providing lt/spangtltspangtpreventive carelt/spangtltspangt within the possibilities of mobile primary health care, providing acute therapies and lt/spangtltspangtfollowinglt/spangtltspangt up with lt/spangtltspangtchronic diseases with checkups and providing the existing therapies the patients take (according to the prescriptions), lt/spangtltspangtor eventually assessinglt/spangtltspangt the situation and lt/spangtltspangtmodifyinglt/spangtltspangt it. In thelt/spangtltspangt conditions where referral to alt/spangtltspangt higher medical instance is required, make sure that referrallt/spangtltspangt is done correctlylt/spangtltspangt and timely. Additionally, transport services will be provided for the vulnerable population that can't reach the higher health instances themselves. lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspangtltbrgtlt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspangtRecognizing the importance of mental health the MHPSS team will be an integrative part of the mobile unit and will provide counselling services (singles and groups), conduct mental health assessments for further actions and refer to the higher instance institutions. Aiming to provide substantial support to the population that is facing emotional and psychological challenges due to the situation. Engagement activities on the prevention and preservation of mental health will be also an important part of implementing activities. lt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtltbrgtThe legal component of the mobile unit will be available to receive legal concerns and matters of the concerned communities and facilitate the problem-solving related to these specific issues. A lawyer will be able to offer legal guidance, advice and consultations related to legal issues that may impact health outcomes individually and overall community stability. Specifically with social assistance issues where possible to intervene, guidance with some referrals and facilitate the further steps in the health care system of the country. ltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtThe staff well-being component will focus on the physical and mental well-being of the project team, ensuring they remain resilient and capable of delivering quality care. Services may include counselling (individual/ group), stress management sessions, and team-building activities. The idea is to provide the same services for the interested partners in case they don't have this specific service or need know-how. lt/pgtltpgtThe number of staff is planned to be between 12-15 ideally having two mobile teams composed of a general doctor, nurse/technician, psychologist, and lawyer. Moving in a suitable and safe vehicle. lt/pgtltpgtltspangtltbrgtlt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspangtThe project will be implemented in full accordance with required standards related to gender inclusion, disability inclusion, AAP, complaint and feedback mechanism and fully implemented PSEA policies. lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgt lt/pgt
